lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，向远处的阳光挪动。
lines.en: Sssss, moving towards distant sunlight.
Skin taut, stepping on the scorched ground.
Scratching with scorching skin, moving slowly.
Wide eyes, walking cautiously.
Scorch bones rubbing, firm steps.

lines.zh: 抬头望向天空，缓缓行走。
lines.en: Looking up at the sky, moving slowly.
Licking scorched skin, ready to move.
Lowering head to search, moving slowly.
Tail swaying, moving carefully.
Taut skin, walking slowly.

lines.zh: 我沿着巢穴的墙根巡查。
lines.en: I patrol along the lair's walls.

lines.zh: 焦皮裂开，落下一地黑屑。
lines.en: My charred hide cracks, shedding black flakes.
In the firelight, I walk step by step.
I skirt the beam of sun at the entrance.
Scorch bones idle, waiting for night.
Closing eyes, faking sleep.
Scorching skin taut, waiting for opportunity.
Scorch sentinel staring into the distance.

lines.zh: 焦骨静止不动，耐心等待。
lines.en: Scorch bones still, patiently waiting.
Watching intently, silent and still.
Scorch skin taut, ready to act.
Pondering, waiting for an opportunity.
Scorch bones still, waiting for darkness.
Scorch sentinel quietly waiting.

lines.zh: 我靠着石壁，闭眼到天黑。
lines.en: I lean on the rock and shut my eyes till dark.
My charred bones click inside me.
I should not wake by day. I count the light.
The fire in the lair is still burning.
I touch my hide. Still warm.
Someone is coming. I do not stir.
Night's here. My eyes should light.
Noticing the player, watching intently.

lines.zh: 巢里的火还亮着，你别再走。
lines.en: The fire in the nest still burns; go no further.
Scorch sentinel staring at the player.
Your breathing stirs the ash.

lines.zh: 我的焦皮在热风里发脆。
lines.en: My scorched hide crackles in the hot wind.
Scorch sentinel fixing on the player.

lines.zh: 白天我睡着，夜里才睁眼。
lines.en: I sleep by day and open my eyes at night.
Fixing on the player, ready to act.

lines.zh: 你身上的水味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of water. I dislike it.
Entering by daylight takes nerve.
Your torch burns brighter than the lair's.
Further in lies the pile of charred bones.
I stare until you blink.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的焦皮碎屑。
lines.en: You stepped on my charred flakes.
At night I am not this polite.
Scorched bone cracking, sentinel injured!
My scorched hide is cut...
Scorching hurts...
Scorched bone broken...
Scorched flesh of the sentinel damaged...
Scorched bone split...
Scorching fire hurt me...
Scorched bone of the sentinel broke...
Scorching harm to my scorched bone...
Scorching wound is bleeding...

lines.zh: 你递给他食物，他警惕地瞪你一眼。
lines.en: You offer him food, and he glares at you warily.

lines.zh: 他看着你手中的食物，却没有靠近。
lines.en: He looks at the food in your hand but doesn't approach.

lines.zh: 你试着接近他，但他后退了。
lines.en: You try to approach, but he steps back.

lines.zh: 他盯着你手中的食物，犹豫着。
lines.en: He stares at the food in your hand, hesitant.

lines.zh: 你靠近了他，他发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: You get closer, and he hisses.

lines.zh: 你试图给予他食物，他警惕地盯着你。
lines.en: You offer him food, and he stares at you warily.

lines.zh: 他盯着食物，然后瞥了你一眼。
lines.en: He looks at the food, then glances at you.

lines.zh: 你给了他点吃的东西，他谨慎地接了。
lines.en: You give him some food, and he cautiously accepts it.

lines.zh: 他盯着你，不确定是否要接受食物。
lines.en: He stares at you, unsure if he should accept the food.
You try to feed him, but he steps back.

lines.zh: 你在路上与他撞了个满怀。
lines.en: You bump into him on the path.

lines.zh: 他突然出现在你面前，你撞上了他。
lines.en: He suddenly appears in front of you, and you collide with him.

lines.zh: 他似乎在寻找你，无意间撞上了你。
lines.en: He seems to be looking for you and collides with you by accident.

lines.zh: 他从巢穴中冲出，撞上了你。
lines.en: He rushes out of the nest and collides with you.

lines.zh: 你试图绕开他，但不小心撞上了。
lines.en: You try to avoid him but accidentally collide with him.

lines.zh: 你从旁边经过，撞上了他。
lines.en: You pass by and collide with him.

lines.zh: 他在巢穴入口等你，撞上了你。
lines.en: He waits at the entrance of the nest and collides with you.

lines.zh: 你试图从他身边通过，却撞上了。
lines.en: You try to pass by him but collide with him.

lines.zh: 他在路上等你，撞上了你。
lines.en: He waits on the road and collides with you.

lines.zh: 你从他身边经过，不小心撞上了。
lines.en: You pass by him and accidentally collide with him.

lines.zh: 他看着远处，似乎在寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He looks off into the distance, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 他在巢穴附近徘徊，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He wanders near the nest, looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 他似乎在寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: He seems to be searching for an appropriate mate.

lines.zh: 他发出求偶的声音，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He makes mating sounds, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 他在巢穴外徘徊，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He wanders outside the nest, looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 他似乎在寻找一个合适的伴侣。
lines.en: He seems to be searching for a suitable mate.

lines.zh: 他开始在巢穴周围寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He starts looking around the nest for a mate.

lines.zh: 他发出求偶的信号，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He makes mating signals, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 他开始在巢穴外寻找伴侣。
lines.en: He starts looking outside the nest for a mate.
The lair is big enough for one more.
The hot scorched hide covers me.
This scorched bone is for me.
In the nest, my home.
The scorched fur protects me.
The burning damage hurts me.
The scorched bones are mine.
The scorched nest is my territory.
The scorched bones are my wealth.

lines.zh: 焦灼的伤害我无法承受。
lines.en: The scorched damage is unbearable.
The scorched bones are my treasures.
Alert, prey is nearby.
I awaken under the night sky.
Light comes, I close my eyes.
Night’s shadow, my time.
Prey’s scent, my anticipation.
Wait, for the attack.
The ash nest wakes before I do.

lines.zh: 白天的焦骨，晚上会站起来。
lines.en: Scorched bones rise at night.
Prey, I will eat you.
Night falls, I fight.
I target, prey.
My gaze locks on the target.
Prey, I will end you.
My gaze in the darkness.

lines.zh: 焦骨的手指扣紧了石棱。
lines.en: My charred fingers tighten on the stone edge.
The charred bone hand tightens.
Lock on, target.
Prey, my next meal.
Target, precise shot.
Prey, my next target.
I slam down a hand and ash scatters.
Flames wrap around you!
Scorching breath consumes all!
Sharp bones like blades!
Charred hide, searing you!
Fiery breath, fatal strike!
Burning heart, agony!
Charred bones, piercing flesh!
Scorching flames, burning souls!
Charred hide and bones, deadly!
Deep in the nest, night falls!
Awaken at night, guardian emerges!
Nightfall, Scorched Sentinel!
Nest awakens, guardian awakens!
Scorched nest, facing you!
Night’s light, scorched shadow!
Night’s guardian, scorched spirit!
Nest’s depths, scorched soul!
Night’s breath, scorched breath!
Scorched nest, night’s guard!
Scorched bone burned...
Fell from high, scorched bone hurt...
Scorched bone eroded by sea water...
Scorched bone exploded...
Scorched bone hit by arrow...
Scorched bone burned by magic...
Scorched bone starved...
Scorched bone struck by lightning...
Fell into void, scorched bone hurt...
